Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: We purchased our Spirit II E-310 propane gas grill this summer. It replaced our 20-year old Silver A. We have used the new grill extensively over the summer and found it to be the best grill ever! It is very well built as are all Weber products. It heats evenly and allows excellent control over the cooking process regardless of the food being cooked. It is, of course, a slightly larger grill as compared to our Silver A 2 burner model so we can cook more food and cook it more quickly due to the increase in BTUs. We added a rotisserie to cook roasts and whole chickens. The flexibility of the 3-burner configuration allows indirect cooking with very good temperature control. Unless you need a really gigantic grill, the E-310 is perfect for the average family grilling needs. An added bonus is that, due to its design, it "sips" the propane thus requiring fewer refills.
Results.Title: The Best Grill!

Results.ReviewText: I've been learning how to cook my whole meal on the grille.  The food has been wonderful.  Not much prep and no pots & pans to clean up.  Just put some oil on the grille and start cooking.  If things are cooked that are a bit messy - like BBQ sauce it is easy to pull apart to clean.
Results.Title: Easy to cook on

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
I got my first used Weber LPG grill in the summer of 1997. A friend had called and asked if I would help him roll his grill out to the road for trash pickup (he had purchased a new stainless steel grill from a warehouse store). I told him that I would help him get his Weber grill to my deck and he could help me get my grill out to the road for trash.
I kept that grill, a used Silver B until the spring of 2018. I replaced the works twice in those 21 years, and she was starting to show her age. As a Father’s day gift, my wife ordered one of those shiny BIG money stainless steel grills and surprised me with it. When I finished assembling it, my neighbor came by and asked it he could take the old one for scrap. I said sure you can. As he rolled it away, he asked if it still worked, to which I replied “it works great. I cooked on it last night”. The next time I was on his deck, that old Silver B was there; he scrapped his grill and kept mine. 
Long story short, that BIG money stainless steel grill turned out to be the most worthless object that has ever been in my possession. After giving it an honest try for about a year, I called the same guy back to come and get it for scrap. In it’s place is a new Weber Spirit II grill. The same great engineering with some awesome updates makes this grill a pleasure to assemble and an even greater pleasure to use!
Results.Title: True Story...

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Replaced a 12 year old  3 burner Spirit and so far has performed great.  I have been using Weber Kettle and Gas grills for over 50 years and wouldn't consider another brand.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Everything is great about this grill, except for the grill lid. It got burn discoloring already, even though I've used for several times only. Not what I expected from Weber. I got the ivory color porcelain enameled lid. I wanted the stainless steel, but was not available. My second choice was the black colour, but it wasn't available too. I don't advise buying this color at all. I should have waited for the stainless to be available.

45010001.Name: Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
